Gain on sales of real estate is printed as a dash for Q3 2024 (zero), with footnote (1) marker on the label. Zero-amount lines (loss on extinguishment, casualty loss, gain on forfeited deposits) are included as printed. Diluted share count 26,161 is already in thousands and reproduces reported per-share figures: 15,658/26,161=0.60, 17,928/26,161=0.69, 20,587/26,161=0.79. AFFO does not subtract recurring capex, so recurring capex of 4,600 (quarter, from Historical Capital Expenditures table) is recorded. Scope of that table is not explicitly stated.
